visual.general_description: Color clinical timeline listing printed diets, clinical events and body mass index labels on dated markers.
visual.detailed_description: Color timeline infographic on a white background: one horizontal blue line with twelve short vertical ticks, each ending in a beige box that carries a printed calendar label. Six boxes sit above the line and six below it, alternating along the line. Text next to the boxes is blue for diet names and black for clinical events; six body mass index values are printed in pink bold type with the unit Kg/m². Printed black text names Ischemic stroke with 78-years-old, male at the left end; Emergency room visit due chronic bronchitis together with Percutaneous endoscopic Gastrotomy (PEG) placement in the second marker group; Gastric residue; Diarrhoea twice; and Normal faeces twice. Blue diet labels read Homemade liquid diet; Homemade liquid diet + Normocaloric enteric formula (four markers);Homemade liquid diet + Main course + Normocaloric enteric formula (one marker); Homemade liquid diet + Hypercaloric enteral formula (one marker); and Anti-diarrhea diet (two markers, one printed Anti- diarrhea diet). The printed pink values read 18.8, 18.2, 15.0, 15.2, 16.2 and 16.8 Kg/m². Every beige box prints a month-and-year or day-month-year calendar label; these dates are not copied here.

Figure 1
Timeline of nutritional status, dietary parameters and clinical features.

limitations: Beige date boxes print calendar dates; they are burned-in dates and are not transcribed. No dates are read from or copied out of the image.

Printed BMI labels were compared with text and Table 1 only qualitatively: a 15.2 label sits under the gastric residue marker, consistent with the Table 1 value for the 8th month and different from the BMI of 15.7 stated in the text. The image values are pixel content and are not used as clinical facts or as a conflict side.
The printed timeline spelling Gastrotomy, Diarrhoea and faeces is transcribed as printed.
